Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 2026

GlobalOnlineVisaApplications respects your privacy. This policy explains how information may be collected, used, stored and protected when you use our website.

1. Information We Collect

When you submit an enquiry or application request, we may collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, country of residence, intended destination, visa type and travel date.

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use submitted information to:

  • Respond to your enquiries.
  • Discuss visa application assistance.
  • Provide requested customer support.
  • Improve our website and services.
  • Meet applicable legal obligations.

3. Sharing Information

We do not sell personal information. Information may be shared with service providers who help operate our website, or with relevant third parties when necessary to provide a service you have requested or comply with the law.

4. Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect information. However, no online system can guarantee absolute security. Please do not submit passport scans, passwords, payment card details or other highly sensitive documents through ordinary website forms.

5. Data Retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, subject to applicable legal requirements.

6. Your Privacy Rights

Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may have rights to request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information. You may contact us to make a request.

7. Cookies

Our website or its hosting providers may use cookies or similar technologies for functionality, security and website performance.

8. Third-Party Services

Our website may use third-party services to host the website, store enquiries or provide other functions. Those services may process information under their own privacy policies.

9. Contact Us

For privacy questions or requests, contact us using the details on our Contact page.

Important: GlobalOnlineVisaApplications is a private visa assistance agency, not a government or embassy website. We do not guarantee visa approval.
